title: Staged Prioritization Runway for Enterprise Security Asks
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit heterogeneous security and compliance requests (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR DPAs, vendor questionnaires) via email, support, and disparate forms. The current intake bundles high and low effort asks together, causing slow SLAs for high-risk items and overcommitment of engineering/security resources.

Goal: Implement a staged prioritization runway that classifies incoming security/compliance asks into time-to-resolution bands (Immediate 0-3 days, Short 3-14 days, Standard 2-8 weeks) and surfaces an automated set of next actions per band. The runway should reduce mean time to first response for high-risk requests by 50% and improve triage throughput without adding headcount.

Scope: This ticket covers defining the prioritization bands, decision rules, intake form changes, dashboard signals, SLA commitments, and a lightweight automation playbook for common questionnaire responses. Separate implementation tickets will cover backend routing, evidence bundler, and legal-approved response templates.
acceptance_criteria: Classification rules defined and documented for Immediate / Short / Standard bands
Updated intake form wireframe with required fields to enable automated classification (PII/data residency, on-prem requirement, model access level, contractual deadline)
Operational SLA table with owner assignments and escalation matrix
Prototype dashboard query that shows queue depth by band and predicted time-to-first-response
Playbook draft for common questionnaires (SOC2 scoping, DPA simple clauses) with approved snippet responses (legal/infosec sign-off)
Rollout plan with canary period and metric targets (MTTR, first-response SLA, %auto-closure)
next_steps: Host kickoff with Legal, InfoSec, Support, and Solutions on 2025-02-03 to align on classification signals
Finalize intake form changes and hand wireframes to Design for 2025-02-07
Create triage rules spreadsheet and seed with 200 historical incoming requests for rule tuning
Build prototype Grafana dashboard query and sample alerts by 2025-02-12
Draft canned response snippets and submit to Legal for review by 2025-02-14
comments: 2025-02-03 - Marco Alvarez: Kickoff completed. Legal requested an explicit field for 'contractual deadline' and InfoSec wants an affirmative checkbox for 'requires encrypted-at-rest storage'. Action: add both to intake form; Priya to coordinate.

2025-02-05 - Priya Patel: Started labeling 200 historical requests. Early signal: 'data residency' and 'model access required' are the strongest predictors for high-effort asks. Will build decision rules around those two attributes first.

2025-02-07 - Sara Nguyen (Design): Shared initial wireframes in drive. Chose a progressive disclosure pattern to avoid scaring off low-risk customers. Link above. Design requests: confirm required/optional fields before dev handoff.

2025-02-10 - Avery Chen (Support): Proposed an automated email ack for Immediate band that includes ETA and owner. Suggestion: template should include link to evidence intake checklist to reduce back-and-forth.

2025-02-12 - Priya Patel: Dashboard prototype shows current MTTR for historical Immediate-classified items = 6.2 days. Target for rollout is 3 days; plan to enable auto-routing to InfoSec on Immediate band and reserve a rotating on-call slot for first-response triage.

2025-02-14 - Legal Review (Priya forwarded): Legal approved canned snippets for DPA questions 2,6,9 pending one wording update. Action: update snippet and re-submit. Legal flagged retention language for GDPR responses — follow-up with Privacy team required.

2025-02-15 - Marco Alvarez: Decision: proceed with canary flow for top 10 customers as Immediate band test. Deliverables before canary: intake form update, email ack template, dashboard alert, on-call rota. Mike (Solutions Eng) to own customer comms.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: more aggressive auto-classification reduces manual triage cost but risks mislabeling complex asks. We will prioritize precision over recall for Immediate band during the canary.
Potential integrations: Zendesk webhook for intake, Okta group for on-call notification, and Evidence Bundler service (separate ticket).
Metrics to watch during canary: %correctly-classified Immediate items, time-to-first-response, number of re-opens after initial answer.
